mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST drops > 10% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in one month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1), it indicates strong consumer demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS growth exceeds GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) where FEDFUNDS is significantly lower than CPIAUCSL indicates a misalignment in monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is lower than CPIAUCSL.
